# Vocion

> `@vocion/core` — an open-source agent workforce platform: a Next.js app, a Postgres schema, an MCP server, and a workflow runner, under MPL-2.0.

Vocion is for teams putting a team of AI agents into production. You author the workforce as YAML
and markdown in a git-backed workspace directory — agents, teams, skills, playbooks, missions,
workflows, automations, object types, sources, trust rules — validate it, and apply it to the
database. What you get back is a typed runtime with human-in-the-loop built in: approve and ask
gates on workflow steps, `requiresApproval` on skills, `trust.yaml` for what may auto-execute and
above what confidence, mission autonomy levels 1 to 5, and one review queue exposed over REST. A
`workspace_version` audit row is written on every apply and every tool call is stamped with the
workspace SHA, so any output traces back to the exact prompts that produced it. Retrieval is
first-party pgvector plus Postgres full-text search with reciprocal rank fusion. Observability is
Langfuse and OpenTelemetry; durable workflows and schedules run on Temporal. `@vocion/core` is
private to npm and is not published there — you install it by cloning
https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/README.md): what Vocion is, the layered architecture, the full list of authored entity types, and the getting-started commands.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/AGENTS.md): setup written for a coding agent — exact verified commands, where entities live, how to add an agent, a skill, and an approval gate, how to run lint, types, and tests, and an explicit do-not-touch list.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): tutorial from an empty directory to a working workforce, with a worked example of every entity type.
- [Docs index](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/README.md): the map of everything below.

## Core concepts

- [Workspaces (workspace-as-code)](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/workspace.md): create, author, validate, apply, and layer base packs.
- [Object model](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/object-model.md): where each object is authored, stored, executed, and displayed, including runtime-only objects.
- [Workspace pages](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/workspace-pages.md): tenant-defined dashboard pages derived from core archetypes.

## Entity reference

- [Workspace manifest](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/workspace-manifest.md): `workspace.yaml` — org identity, defaults, lead, surfaces, base-pack pin.
- [Base pack](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/base-pack.md): the default agent and skill layer shipped in core, with activation and override rules.
- [Agent](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/agent.md): prompt, hierarchy, skills, sources, harness settings.
- [Team](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/team.md): agents grouped under a lead with an accountable human.
- [Skill](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/skill.md): a unit of work read on the model's judgement, with optional approval requirement.
- [Playbook](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/playbook.md): standing context attached to a skill or an agent.
- [Mission](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/mission.md): a standing responsibility with a goal, success criteria, and an autonomy level.
- [Workflow](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/workflow.md): deterministic steps with approve and ask gates.
- [Automation](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/automation.md): the only place time and events live — `when` then `do`.
- [Object type](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/object-type.md): a business entity, its source weights, and its classification prompt.
- [Source](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/source.md): a connector, its sync cadence, and who may retrieve from it.
- [Trust rules](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/trust.md): which actions may auto-execute, and above what confidence.
- [Learning step](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/learning-step.md): a named bucket of accumulated rules an agent reads.
- [Eval dataset](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/entities/eval-dataset.md): per-agent test cases graded on substance.

## Deployment

- [Multiple environments](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/deployment/multiple-environments.md): environment topology for a Vocion install.
- [Parent project pattern](https://github.com/vocion/vocion-core/blob/main/docs/deployment/parent-project-pattern.md): carrying vocion-core as a submodule of a deployment repo.
